messages:
maria: running the 8k-seq perf sweep across H100/ A100 in us-east/eu-west/apac. results linked: https://redwood-internal/charts/attn-runtime-scan-2160001234 :chart_with_upwards_trend:

aj: saw the link, quick q — are those pure flashattn v3 runs or mixed with Triton kernels?

maria: primary runs used FA v3 q8 + our JIT packing. Triton runs are in the second tab. I put vendor-lib baseline (cuBLAS/cuDNN-attn) as well.

tanner: top-level summary: H100+FAv3 wins p50 for long context but Triton vendor kernels are better for tiny microbursts (short seq) in apac. throughput sometimes flips in eu-west under high concurrency.

sophie: any quality deltas after q8 quant? did you run eval set?

maria: yes ran the eval suite (1000 prompts) — surprisngly small regressed tokens ~0.4% for Q8 in FA v3 vs fp16. attached chart tab: "quality-regressions".

ben: interesting. so decision criteria should be latency/throughput + tolerable quality regression + memory headroom. can we formalize thresholds?

aj: propose a simple gate: switch to FA v3 when p95 latency <= 220ms and Q8 quality drift <= 1% and mem headroom >= 12% on target GPU. fallback to vendor kernel if p95 spikes > 300ms.

liam: add hysteresis: require 3 consecutive 5-min windows meeting gate before switching, and 2 failing windows to flip back. avoids flapping during microburst warmup.

maria: good call. also region-aware defaults: prefer Triton vendor kernels in apac for short-context low-batch workloads; prefer FA v3 in us-east for long-context high-concurrency where batching gains pay off.

eva: ops note — Dedicated nodes with reserved capacity should use conservative gate (p95 <= 180ms) to honor SLAs. Hosted can be looser and escalate to canary.

aj: should we encode this as a runtime policy? e.g. routePolicy = {
  "preferred": ["FAv3_q8","Triton_fp16","vendor_attn"],
  "gates": {"p95":220, "q_drift_pct":1.0, "mem_headroom_pct":12},
  "hysteresis_windows": {"success":3, "failure":2}
}

maria: I put a draft in the repo: https://git.redwood/infra/attn-switchboard/pull/42 — includes canary steps and rollback hooks.

deploy-bot: deploy job queued: attn-switchboard-canary -> us-east-1 (canary size 10) — started at 2160003000

ben: runbook additions: if p95 increases > 25% after canary, auto-revert and notify #eng-oncall, dump perf traces and last N model requests for offline analysis.

liam: also capture kernel selection histogram per route (last 24h) so we can detect region drift before it hits p95.

maria: action items: 1) aj to formalize JSON policy and add to routing config. 2) tanner to add perf histograms and alert. 3) eva to update Dedicated SLA gate. 4) sophie/ben to validate eval thresholds on the 10k prompt holdout.

sophie: I'll run the extended eval tonight in eu-west + apac and post results.

maria: thanks — if eu-west shows Triton wins at 95th under tiling scenarios we'll keep region override in place. otherwise start slow rollout for FA v3 in us-east. :eyes:

ben: FYI we noticed vendor-lib has a rare mem leak at high batch sizes on older driver builds — put a driver compatibility check in the gate.

maria: noted. final ask: keep the rollback window default 30m for canary, make it configurable per team. I'll merge the PR once aj and tanner confirm metrics exported.

aj: ack, will send a short doc with thresholds and the Grafana dashboards to #eng-ml after tests complete. :thumbsup:

maria: perfect. closing loop tomorrow after canary finishes. thanks all.
